about: Poly Haven (CC0) assets by role for the Blender sets. tools/polyhaven.py sync downloads them to assets/polyhaven/<id>/; blender/world/paper_materials.py (ph_* helpers) mixes the textures into the SET MATERIALS and blender/sets/build_set.py lights the world with the HDRIs when a set has "polyhaven": true. Texture fields: tile = metres one texture repeat covers, detail = how much of the photo's light/dark pattern multiplies the procedural colour (0..1), tint = how far the colour moves toward the photo's hue (0..1; low keeps the set palette), bump = displacement weight added to the procedural bump, rough = how much the photo's roughness variation is added, ao = crevice darkening from the AO map, grain = object axis the photo's V direction follows on side faces (wood grain, bark, culms). HDRI fields: gain = ambient relative to the procedural sky it replaces for lighting (1.0 = same mean radiance, measured by a tiny equirect render; or ambient = an absolute mean radiance; the camera still sees the procedural sky), reflect = how much of the HDRI glossy rays see (default 0.25, so water still mirrors the visible sky), clamp = brightest value kept as a multiple of the mean (removes the photographed sun so the set's own sun / moon lamp casts the only hard shadow), sat = saturation, match = how far the photo's overall colour is pulled to the procedural sky's average colour (default 0.7: the set keeps its art-directed mood, the photo adds directional variation), rot = extra yaw in degrees after the brightest spot is turned to the set's sun azimuth.
